name: PHRX 5164
title: Professional Experience in Infectious Disease II
description: The student will apply knowledge, skills and attitudes to the provision of care to unique patients with infectious diseases. Emphasis is on optimizing medication-related outcomes in patients through medication therapy management, interprofessional collaboration, and patient/caregiver education. Direct patient contact.
requirement_description: PHRX 5047 or PHRX 5065; open to students in the School of Pharmacy.
